title: Workforce: the creative team across time
lede: Team is the main workspace. See staff and interns by area, move between terms, and use Hiring for openings and candidate review. All people shown are fictional.

sections.heading: Team first
sections.note: Matched viewport, fictional roster, shared tokens and clock. The baseline uses the preserved original page and person card; the after capture uses the actual new TeamView. Server data and Next navigation are adapted in the fixture.

pairs.title: Current team
pairs.beforeCap: A current-roster list with staff and interns mixed in each area.
pairs.afterCap: Area teams separate staff and interns, show recorded managers, and expose academic-year and term navigation.

changes.was: Current staffing was a flat sequence of area rosters.
changes.now: Staff and interns are separated within each creative area; profile links, sports, managers and graduation cues stay close to each person.

changes.was: The main view only represented active profiles today.
changes.now: Past terms use recorded intern placements, including former interns. Future terms distinguish recorded placements from projected returns and flag incomplete graduation dates.

changes.was: Management controls dominated the hiring toolbar; viewing and sorting were temporary.
changes.now: Review next, quick views, URL-backed filters/sort and cycle links make review easier. Planning uses explicit cycle hiring goals.

verification: 220 focused Hiring/Workforce tests and 11 CLI tests passed.
Typecheck and touched-file lint passed; app build passed, with the pre-existing unrelated Sidebar unused-variable warning.

Nine checks passed against actual components with fictional data: filters, term selection and prefill, future graduates, historical membership, mobile width, planning goals, review order, URL reload, and linked materials. No browser errors.
Matched desktop, narrow-screen, dark appearance, empty history, future/history, person drawer, Hiring and Planning renders were inspected.
notes: Local changes only. No staffing or applicant data changed in this pass, and no commit, push or deployment occurred.
Historical staff/manager membership is not recorded. Historical names and graduation fields reflect current profiles, so this is not an immutable snapshot.
The annual Looking ahead headcount uses profile assignments; exact term placements are shown in Team. Hires awaiting accounts appear in Looking ahead.
The merged branch has no managed preview. Fixture evidence does not establish authenticated Next routing, server authorization or persistent writes.
